full_prompt_en: A square Japanese woodblock-style print presents a close view of a woman whose pale face turns gently down and to the right. Her dark hair is arranged in broad sculptural side sections and a high top fold, secured by long pale hairpins and a decorated comb. Carefully arched black brows, elongated eyes with a hint of vermilion at the corners, a small straight nose, and restrained red lips define a quiet, inward expression. The smooth cream face occupies the central area, giving the eye a calm place to rest among dense ornament. Her layered collar has fine dark swirling pattern, bordered by warm red bands, while dark teal and maroon patterned garments fill the lower edges. Behind her, floral scrolls, blossoms, and geometric textile-like shapes pack the ground in ocher, brick red, deep blue-green, cream, and black. A small vertical printed inscription is partly visible at the lower right, but the characters are not the focal point. The image is built from fine dark outlines, flat areas of pigment, and precise curved hatching in the hair. Slight misregistration, grain, and aged paper texture soften the colors without obscuring the crisp facial contour. There is little Western perspective or cast shadow; depth is supplied by overlap between hair, face, clothing, and decorative backdrop. The framing crops the hairstyle near the top and the garment at the bottom, making the composition intimate yet ornate. The mood is elegant and measured, balancing the open pale face against a highly saturated field of printed pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形日本木版画风格作品近距离呈现一名女子，她浅色面孔轻轻向右下转。深发梳成宽阔雕塑般的两侧发髻与高耸顶髻，以长浅色簪子和装饰梳固定。精心画出的黑色弯眉、眼角略染朱红的细长双眼、小而直的鼻子与克制的红唇，组成安静内敛的神情。平滑奶油色面孔占据中央，让目光在繁密装饰中有一处安定位置。多层衣领有细致深色回旋纹样，并由暖红边带包住；深青与栗红花纹衣料填满下边缘。她身后，花卉卷草、盛开的花和织物般几何形以赭黄、砖红、深蓝绿、奶油色与黑色密密铺开。右下可见一小列印刷文字，但字形并非焦点。画面由细深色轮廓、平涂色域与头发上精确弯曲的排线构成。轻微套印错位、颗粒和旧纸肌理柔化色彩，却没有掩盖清晰的面部轮廓。几乎没有西式透视或投影；纵深来自头发、面孔、衣服与装饰背景的相互遮挡。取景在顶部裁切发髻、底部裁切衣料，使构图亲密又华丽。气氛优雅而有分寸，让开放的浅色面孔与高饱和印花场域保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: Traditional woodblock-print aesthetics favor precise ink contours, broad flat pigment areas, and fine directional hatching over blended shading. Warm aged paper shows through cream passages, while brick red, ocher, dark teal, maroon, and black create a densely woven decorative field. Curved parallel marks can model hair or other dark surfaces without turning them into smooth gradients. Layered patterned planes overlap with little linear perspective, and the clearest unpatterned area gives the eye a place to pause. Slight print grain, imperfect registration, and worn pigment keep the surface tactile. Cropped forms, repeated floral curves, and slim rectangular inscriptions can enrich the edges without distracting from the main contour. The visual character is ornate yet controlled, built on the tension between busy textile-like motifs and a quiet pale center.
style_prompt_zh: 传统木版画美学重视精确墨线轮廓、宽阔平涂色域和细密方向性排线，而非晕染阴影。暖色旧纸从奶油色区域显出，砖红、赭黄、深青、栗红与黑色则织成繁密装饰场。平行曲线可塑造头发或其他深色表面，却不把它们磨成平滑渐层。带纹平面彼此遮叠，少用线性透视；最清楚的无纹区域让视线得以停驻。轻微印刷颗粒、不完美套色与磨旧颜料使表面可触。局部裁切、重复花卉曲线和狭长矩形题记可丰富边缘，而不分散主轮廓。视觉气质华丽却受控，建立在繁忙织物般纹样与安静浅色中心之间的张力上。
theme_en: A poised woman with an elaborate coiffure appears amid dense floral pattern
theme_zh: 一名盘着精致发髻的女子置身繁密花卉纹样之中
name: Utagawa Kunisada
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
